name: terracotta
description: Build accessible UI with Terracotta, the headless component library for SolidJS. Component catalogue and part names, subpath imports, controlled vs uncontrolled state, render props, the `as` prop and prop passthrough, `tc-*` styling attributes, `unmount`, transitions, and keyboard and focus behaviour. Use when writing, reviewing or debugging SolidJS code that imports from `terracotta`.
